domain.name: News and Current Events
domain.description: Breaking news, disasters, politics, world events, investigations, human interest
domain.powerWords: breaking, shocking, urgent, hidden, never, stop, truth, secret, revealed, crisis, exclusive, devastating, confirmed, alarming

principles.principle: Lead with specific numbers and names — never vague labels
Frame events as having hidden context or untold stories
Use period-separated fragments for dramatic rhythm — "13 Dead. Mall Collapsed."
